scope: Read-only static review plus 700 additional deterministic standalone adversarial calls; no app database imports, paid calls, answer packets or model inference.
verified: Snapshot digest binds the complete ordered source tuple, including unreferenced and future original turns; exact question hash and as-of representation are checked.
Quote source IDs, full-source and exact selected Unicode-codepoint slice hashes and ranges are validated against immutable originals.
Roots, typed dependency endpoints, cycles, duplicate edges, orphan spans, overlapping source ranges and unresolved declarations are checked before emission.
Future source or declared unresolved dependency refuses the entire unit with empty preview; budget nonfit also returns empty preview and no quote receipts.
Preview uses one JSON object per physical line; emitted and omitted ranges partition each referenced original source. Adjacent spans coalesce without losing individual decoded receipt offsets.

Independent 500-case deterministic probe covered newline, CR, tab, NEL, U+2028, U+2029, combining marks, emoji, backslash, JSON-like framing, exact decoded quote receipts and one-character-under budget refusal.
Additional 200 deterministic multi-span cases verified adjacent coalescence, every decoded per-span receipt, and complete selected/omitted partition of each referenced source.
scope_limits: Typed edges and proposer declarations are structurally checked, not semantically validated. A proposal can omit a necessary negation, correction, antecedent, event distinction or out-of-window qualifier and still receive structural PASS. Semantic completeness remains NOT_CERTIFIED.

Refused reports contain source/span IDs and dependency metadata; budget refusals expose required character length, while quote content, emitted ranges and receipts remain absent. Keep reports internal if metadata confidentiality matters.
Dependency graph details are in the companion report, not the JSONL preview itself. Preserve their binding and inspect both together.
No real-source all500 stress replay or retrieval/candidate/answer-gain audit was part of this review; those are separate later gates.
